name: NetworkFortigateEvent
description: FortiGate event and UTM logs (type=event and type=utm). Ref: https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/7.6.6/fortios-log-message-reference/357866/log-message-fields. Fields above _fields are shared across FortiGate log families (see FortigateTraffic for matching definitions); subtype-specific columns are held in _fields as a JSON bag keyed by logid.

fields.name: TimeGenerated
fields.description: Event timestamp (UTC). Raw: eventtime (epoch nanoseconds). Conversion: eventtime / 1000000 → INT64 epoch milliseconds. Fallback: parse date + time + tz if eventtime is absent.

fields.name: _Size
fields.description: Internal record size in bytes, used for ingestion accounting. Not sourced from FortiGate.

fields.name: _Type
fields.description: The name of the table/index. This field will be set by the index engine.

fields.name: logid
fields.description: Log ID. See https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/7.6.6/fortios-log-message-reference/656858/log-id-definitions. Raw: logid (string).

fields.name: type
fields.description: Log type (event or utm for this table). See https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/7.6.6/fortios-log-message-reference/374445/type. Raw: type (string).

fields.name: subtype
fields.description: Subtype of the log. See https://docs.fortinet.com/document/fortigate/7.6.6/fortios-log-message-reference/195419/subtype. Raw: subtype (string).

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action taken or session status. For UTM logs this is the security action (e.g. blocked, passthrough); for event logs this describes the event action. Raw: action (string).

fields.name: date
fields.description: Day, month, and year when the log was recorded. Raw: date (string).

fields.name: devid
fields.description: Serial number of the device for the traffic's origin. Raw: devid (string).

fields.name: devname
fields.description: Name of the device for the traffic's origin. Raw: devname (string).

fields.name: direction
fields.description: Message/packet direction. Raw: direction (string).

fields.name: dstcountry
fields.description: Name of the destination country. Raw: dstcountry (string).

fields.name: dstintf
fields.description: Interface of the traffic's destination. Raw: dstintf (string).

fields.name: dstip
fields.description: Destination IP address. Raw: dstip (string, IPv4/IPv6).

fields.name: dstintfrole
fields.description: Role of the destination interface. Raw: dstintfrole (string).

fields.name: dstport
fields.description: Port number of the traffic's destination. Raw: dstport (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: eventtime
fields.description: Epoch time in nanoseconds the log was triggered by FortiGate. Raw: eventtime (epoch nanoseconds). Conversion: stored as INT64.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Security level rating (e.g. notice, warning, error). Raw: level (string).

fields.name: policyid
fields.description: ID of the firewall policy governing the traffic. Raw: policyid (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: proto
fields.description: IP protocol number (6=TCP, 17=UDP, etc.). Raw: proto (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: service
fields.description: Name of the service. Raw: service (string).

fields.name: srcintf
fields.description: Interface name of the traffic's origin. Raw: srcintf (string).

fields.name: srccountry
fields.description: Name of the source country. Raw: srccountry (string).

fields.name: sessionid
fields.description: ID for the session. Raw: sessionid (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: srcdomain
fields.description: Source domain (e.g. Active Directory domain) of the originating user or host. Raw: srcdomain (string).

fields.name: srcintfrole
fields.description: Role of the source interface. Raw: srcintfrole (string).

fields.name: srcip
fields.description: IP address of the traffic's origin. Raw: srcip (string, IPv4/IPv6).

fields.name: srcport
fields.description: Port number of the traffic's origin. Raw: srcport (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Hour clock when the log was recorded. Raw: time (string).

fields.name: tz
fields.description: Timezone offset of the log timestamp (e.g. -0800, +0000). Raw: tz (string).

fields.name: vd
fields.description: Name of the virtual domain in which the log was recorded. Raw: vd (string).

fields.name: vrf
fields.description: Virtual Routing and Forwarding (VRF) identifier. Raw: vrf (int). Conversion: int → INT32.

fields.name: msg
fields.description: Human-readable log message text. Raw: msg (string).

fields.name: app
fields.description: Name of the application. Raw: app (string).

fields.name: appcat
fields.description: Category of the application. Raw: appcat (string).

fields.name: user
fields.description: Authenticated user name. Raw: user (string).

fields.name: unauthuser
fields.description: Unauthenticated user name (e.g. source identity before authentication). Raw: unauthuser (string).

fields.name: group
fields.description: User group name. Raw: group (string).

fields.name: hostname
fields.description: Host name of a URL. Raw: hostname (string).

fields.name: url
fields.description: URL address. Raw: url (string).

fields.name: _fields
fields.description: Extended fields not modeled as top-level columns. Contents vary by logid (each FortiGate event/utm subtype emits its own set of extra key=value pairs). Raw: remainder of the log line after the modeled fields are extracted. Conversion: serialized as a JSON object and stored as UTF8 string with kusto_dynamic_json hint so KQL can walk it with . and [] operators.
